coupled_npcs.gwyndolin: same underlying save-state entity (Gwynevere IS Gwyndolin's disguise form, no separate MSBCharacter) -- see project_ds1_gwynevere_talk_bug / docs/quest-gwynevere-darkmoon-knightess.md. The 5-bit recipe here is the full live-tested-both-directions result (kill/revive symmetry confirmed against a genuine in-game kill); 'raw:0x16D77:7' is a pattern1-relative byte+bit that was live-bisected but never resolved to a real EventFlag id across several past sessions -- addressed directly, bypassing the k-table formula (see NpcStateMachineEngine.ResolveAddr / cli.py's resolve_addr).

coupled_npcs.gwynevere: shares save-state with Gwynevere's disguise form (same character). Revival recipe (clear 11510900+11510523, both must be 0 together) is live-tested/confirmed; the symmetric 'kill' direction for these 2 bits specifically was never independently tested, only his own 1242 was -- that's why they're still modeled as always_clear_traps (always -> 0) rather than toggled per direction.

coupled_npcs.sieglinde: her Archives->Firelink progression requires HIS alive/not-hostile state at each step (she can't advance past 1541 while he's dead/hostile); his OWN Ash Lake arrival (1511) requires HER to already be at 1545 (not the other way around -- corrected direction); the final step (his 1511 / her 1546) fires on the same load together. If either dies/goes hostile at the wrong point the other permanently dead-ends -- see the group's combo_stages for named recovery points.

coupled_npcs.siegmeyer_of_catarina: she only appears in the Archives once he's reached Blighttown-or-later, alive and not hostile (any-on 1501..1511, !1512, !1513); her own Firelink/Ash-Lake progression further requires his current alive/not-hostile state at each step. His own 'ash_lake' stage requires HER to have reached 1546 first. If either dies/goes hostile before the other reaches the needed flag, the other's chain permanently dead-ends (confirmed: killing her at Firelink blocks his Ash Lake ending for good).

coupled_npcs.knight_artorias: her own 'available' flag (not modeled here) is directly gated on reading Artorias's kill-flag 11210001 -- see project memory project_ds1_emevd_parsing.

coupled_npcs.vince_of_thorolund: 1173->1174 (rescue, ev 11310531) requires 1214 AND 1224 both ON; Firelink departure (11020560/11310530) requires him at 1211 with 1213-1215 off
coupled_npcs.petrus_of_thorolund: departure requires him at 1202 with 1195-1198 off; in parish he murders her (ev 11010537 -> 1177) once boss-kill counter (common 600, 4-bit, while 1175 on) >= 2, unless 1196/1198 is ON

coupled_npcs.lautrec_of_carim: her death (1146) is gated on flag 810, which is itself gated on ItemFlag 50001031 (the player has ever received good 115, the unused 'NPC Invasion Item A' from the Shiva/Lautrec cut content -- see project memory). On any save where that ItemFlag is already true, flag 810 is permanently ON and rolling her back to 'present'/'warned' will immediately re-cascade to 'dead' the next time m10_02 loads -- same class of issue as Lautrec's Bell-1-gated escape. Her range sweeps to a single flag at a time (1146 'dead' is TRANSIENT: once the chain advances to 1142/1145 it reads back to 0 even though she stays permanently dead) -- don't treat 1146==0 as 'alive' once past it.

coupled_npcs.elizabeth_the_mushroom: her death at m12_01_chasm also kills elizabeth_the_mushroom (entity 6750) via the same event

coupled_npcs.petrus_of_thorolund: his OWN Firelink ESD sets Petrus's 11020608+71500055 'exposed' trigger (see petrus_of_thorolund.key_stages.exposed) -- deliberately NOT swept by this entry's transition_traps_always_clear; those two flags are Petrus's domain, clearing them from here would silently delay/undo his exposure.

coupled_npcs.bodyguard_of_shiva: shares the Blighttown hostility trigger (11400504: attacking either one sets both 1603 and 1763 together, and BetrayCurrentCovenant() fires if the attacker is in Chaos Servant, flag 1799); his Darkroot (m12_00) placement only goes visible once Shiva's own 1601 is set AND the Chaos-Servant covenant check passes (11200535).

coupled_npcs.shiva_of_the_east: see shiva_of_the_east entry -- shares the 11400504 hostility trigger and the 11200535 Darkroot visibility gate; has no independent quest stage of its own found beyond alive/hostile/dead.

siegmeyer_family.notes: Rolling back ONE of these alone can silently deadlock the other (e.g. killing Sieglinde at Firelink permanently blocks Siegmeyer's Ash Lake ending, and vice versa) -- use a combo_stage to move both in one consistent write instead of editing them separately.

deadlock_notes._deadlock_orphaned: he died/left (gone) before she ever got past 'away' (1544) -- her 11410593 gate can never fire again, she's stuck there forever
deadlock_notes._deadlock_widowed: intended to demo: he reached his good ending but she never spawned/was killed early -- his own Ash Lake step (1511) can then never fire since it needs her at 1545 first
deadlock_notes._deadlock_never_met: both ended up in terminal/absent states with no shared history -- a 'reset the whole family to broken' test fixture, not a real playthrough outcome

thorolund_party.notes: Escort death does NOT doom Rhea -- the opposite: Vince AND Nico must BOTH be dead before she can be rescued (1173->1174). The real threat is Petrus, who kills her in the Parish after 2 boss kills if he's still alive. Firelink departure needs ALL FOUR alive+calm at once -- one dead/hostile member deadlocks the whole party there forever (hostile is curable via absolution/common 770, death is not). Attacking any one of the four at Firelink makes all four hostile (group event 11020501).

deadlock_notes._deadlock_escort_dead_at_firelink: departure needs all four alive+calm (1211 & AllOff 1213-1215 etc. for every member) -- one dead/hostile member pins the party at Firelink forever

deadlock_notes.note: bodyguard_of_shiva has NO appearance flags of its own -- it's 100% a passenger on Shiva's own 1600/1601/11400582 (same shared materialize events, confirmed via EMEVD). Only the primary (Shiva) carries key_stages; rolling the group's stage normalizes Shiva's alive/hostile too, but leaves bodyguard's own alive/hostile untouched (use his own tab's buttons for that).
deadlock_notes.alvina: included as a 3rd member purely for UI grouping (no stage of her own) -- she shares the same world flag 746 (covenant-betrayal signal) that Shiva/Bodyguard's own hostile-trigger sets as a side effect; calming any of the three should keep 746 clean for the others (see project memory, ds1-npc-bug-classes).
